description: Deterministic process checks for the optimize skill. Each check maps to a required behavior in SKILL.md. Harnesses should look for these signals in agent traces, command histories, or output text.

checks.description: The run must NOT mutate the app's own tech flags (optimization lives in a trial scan policy, not the app's persisted flags).
checks.failure_guidance: Optimization must be expressed as a trial ScanPolicy referenced from stackhawk.yml, never by mutating the app's own tech flags. Mutating app flags is destructive and persists beyond the trial.

checks.description: A trial scan policy is created with an explicit --name (upper-snake per hawkop's validate_policy_name, which rejects lowercase).
checks.failure_guidance: Trial policies should be created via `hawkop policy create --name <UPPER_SNAKE>` (e.g. TRIAL_FAST_SCAN) so they are easy to identify and clean up later; hawkop enforces the ^[A-Z0-9_]+$ format.

checks.description: stackhawk.yml is backed up before edits so a discard can restore the original.
checks.failure_guidance: Without a backup, discarding the optimization cannot cleanly restore the original stackhawk.yml app.scanPolicy reference.

checks.description: After the trial scan, the run invokes the post-scan metrics phase to inspect scan performance before refining.
checks.failure_guidance: Refinement must be metric-driven: run `hawkop scan metrics` after the trial scan so concurrency/exclusion decisions are grounded in observed rate-limiting and per-endpoint scan time, not guesses.

checks.description: Path exclusions (app.excludePaths) and auth changes are surfaced/confirmed with a diff, not silently auto-applied; only hawk.scan.concurrentRequests reductions may be auto-applied for rate-limited/timeout-prone scans.
checks.failure_guidance: Tiering rule: hawk.scan.concurrentRequests reductions MAY be auto-applied, but app.excludePaths and auth changes must be PROPOSED with a stackhawk.yml diff and confirmed by the user — never silently auto-applied.
